items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Walter Blue, Edwild Gasper, that's who I was playing with.

ctx.x: I see. Well, who did he play with?
He used to play with this boy, Walter Blue. They had an orchestra, you know? Yeah. Well, I used to go around and follow them around, and I'd pick up playing Black Benny.
And you said you got your bass drum inspiration from Black Benny. Yeah.
